page_shape.entry: Posting page has <a> 'Apply Now' -> /postings/<uuid>/applications/new (locale prefix /en/ optional). Blank form renders fully on load.
page_shape.save_for_later: button#application-save-later-link 'Save application for later' (not exercised; likely prompts email)

control_families.text: input[type=text|email|tel|number] with name application_form[application][<field>] and id application_form_application_<field>; <label for> gives clean label; required via native required attr (no '*' in label).
control_families.combobox_react_select: react-select control (div[class*=select__control]) whose input id equals the field name (e.g. application_form[application][country]). A HIDDEN native <select> mirror with the same id / *_mobile_select id holds the full option list, so options are readable without opening the menu. Option[0] is always 'Select...'.
control_families.address_autocomplete: button 'Start typing an address' (pp-02, pp-03) precedes Street Address/City/State/Zipcode; manual inputs address1/address2/postcode required, town(State) react-select.
control_families.file: input[type=file] name application_form[application][cv] accept=application/msword,…wordprocessingml.document,application/pdf single; label 'Attach Résumé / CV'; not required on any sample.
control_families.textarea: textarea#personal-summary (optional) and textarea id application_form_application_answers_attributes_<i>_text_answer for custom text questions.
control_families.radio_boolean: custom yes/no questions render as two radios name application_form[application][answers_attributes][<i>][boolean_answer] values true/false, labelled Yes/No with aria-labelledby question text. NOT marked required in DOM even when likely mandatory.
control_families.custom_select: custom choice questions render as react-select with hidden select id application_form_application_answers_attributes_<i>_mobile_select.
control_families.consent_checkbox: input[type=checkbox]#application_process_information required, label '(Required) Allow us to process your personal information. *'
control_families.submit: button[type=submit] text 'Submit Application' in section '4. Submit Application'

blockers.detail: reCAPTCHA Enterprise anchor iframes (recaptcha.net) on Brivo custom-domain instance; none on Portnox/Thorne native pages
No login required; 'Apply with LinkedIn' is optional OAuth
Yes/No work-authorization, sponsorship, criminal-history and referral radios; state-residency select. Radios are not DOM-required, so server-side validation is unknown.
Thorne marks Gender/Gender Identity/Ethnicity/Disability/Veteran as required; must route to human ('Prefer Not To Say' exists).

runtime_observations: Read options from the hidden <select> (same id as the combobox input, or *_mobile_select) rather than opening react-select menus.
Labels: use <label for=id>; for react-select the label is the sibling <label> ('near:') and aria-describedby points at the 'Select...' placeholder, not the label.
Salary/compensation questions are numeric inputs: send digits only.
Locale prefix /en/ appears on some tenants; the same form exists with and without it.

inferred.confidence: medium-high across 3 employers; custom question sets vary per employer
not_observed: server-side required validation for radio questions

provider_hint.detect: form#application-form + input[name^='application_form[application]'] + 'Save application for later'; hostname *.pinpointhq.com OR custom domain with /postings/<uuid>/applications/new
provider_hint.for_jev: Pinpoint: single-page form. Sections Personal Details (first/last/preferred name, email, phone, LinkedIn URL, country/state react-selects, street/city/zip required), Profile (optional CV pdf/doc/docx, optional Personal Summary textarea), Questions (employer custom: yes/no radios for work auth/sponsorship/referral/criminal history, numeric salary, select 'how did you hear', consent selects, free-text referral/preferred-name), optional or REQUIRED demographic selects, required privacy checkbox, then 'Submit Application'. Hard narrative prompts seen: none beyond Personal Summary; salary number required on 2 of 3.

edge_cases.detail: careers.brivo.com serves the identical Pinpoint template with reCAPTCHA Enterprise added.
